(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.showTab('player'); __app.player.video.pause(); return 'ok'; })()

(async()=>{ __app.player.openExport(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); const row=[...m.querySelectorAll('.row-field')].find(r=>/Even out loudness/.test(r.innerText)); row.querySelector('.toggle, .switch, button')?.click?.(); const t=[...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/Test 10 seconds/.test(b.textContent)); t.click(); for(let i=0;i<120;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(/Test: 10 s took/.test(m.innerText)) break; } const note=[...m.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e=>e.childNodes[0]?.textContent?.startsWith('Test: 10 s took')); return (note?.innerText || m.innerText.slice(-300)).split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' '); })()

(async()=>{ const jobs=await vr180.queueList(); const j=jobs.find(x=>x.test); return j ? (j.stage + ' · ' + j.output + ' · ' + (j.size/1e6).toFixed(1) + ' MB in ' + j.elapsed.toFixed(1) + ' s') : 'no test job'; })()

(async()=>{ document.querySelector('.modal .card-head button')?.click(); document.querySelector('.jobs-btn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const sel=document.querySelector('.jobs-foot select'); sel.value='sleep'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const it=__app.player.current(); const done=new Promise(r=>vr180.onJobDone(r)); await vr180.queueAdd([{ input: it.path, output: 'C:/Users/Owner/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/vrt/whendone_test.mp4', projection: 'fisheye', layout: 'sbs', fov: 180, codec: 'h264', crf: 30, start: 0, end: 1 }]); await done; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const strip=document.getElementById('strip').innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' | '); const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('#strip button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Cancel'); btn?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const s=await vr180.getSettings(); return strip + ' || select now: ' + sel.value + ' · saved setting: ' + s.whenDone; })()
